BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of a leaching test in state waterquality certifications; and adding a new section to chapter 90.48 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.48 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In order to ensure that major construction projects involving theuse of large quantities of fill material do not pose a threat to waterquality, the department shall require that the chemical suitability ofpotential fill material be determined through use of a leaching test ofthe type specified in WAC 173340747(7), as it existed on January 1,2003, in all water quality certifications issued under section 401 ofthe federal clean water act and administrative orders issued under thischapter where such certification or administrative order authorizes theplacement of more than two million cubic yards of fill material, someor all of which will be placed in waters of the state. Thisrequirement must be retroactively applied to all water qualitycertifications and administrative orders issued by the department thatauthorized the placement of more than two million cubic yards of fillmaterial where the placement is not substantially completed by June 1, p. 1 SB 57872003. This section does not apply to section 401 certifications andorders authorizing the placement of fill material that has been dredgedfrom waters of the United States.
